Package index

Area of interest

One representation of “where”, handed to each service in the form and the coordinate system it expects.

as_aoi() is_aoi()
Define an area of interest
aoi_geom() aoi_bbox()
Geometry and bounding box of an area of interest
rgeopl_example()
Example areas of interest shipped with the package

What data exist here

The indexes, one row per tile: vintage, format, download link and the tile outline. Nothing is downloaded until you ask.

dem_request() pointcloud_request() ortho_request()
What elevation, point cloud and orthophoto data exist for an area
coverage() plot_coverage()
Summarise and draw index coverage by vintage
tile_download()
Download the tiles an index points to
tile_mosaic()
Join downloaded tiles into one raster
ortho_stack()
Orthophoto as one four-band raster
ortho_pairs()
Which orthophoto vintages publish both products
pointcloud_get()
Point cloud tiles, downloaded and identified

Ready-made rasters

The coverage services: the current model clipped to your area, with no tiles to mosaic. Point clouds are not available this way.

dem_get() ortho_get()
Download an elevation model or an orthophoto for an area
chm_get() chm_build()
Canopy height for an area
chm_years()
Which vintages can make a canopy height model
dem_to_datum()
Convert an elevation model between Poland's two height systems
open_raster()
Open a downloaded raster, with its coordinate system attached

Forest units

The State Forests hierarchy, searchable by name or by forest address, and the stand subareas underneath it.

bdl_directorates() bdl_inspectorates() bdl_ranges() bdl_subareas() bdl_compartments()
Forest administrative units and subareas
bdl_unit()
Find a forest unit by name
bdl_by_address()
Find a forest unit by its address
bdl_catalogue()
List every forest unit in Poland
bdl_overview()
The State Forests at a glance
parse_forest_address()
Split a forest address into its parts

Protected areas

Nature conservation as the register holds it, from the body that keeps it: the Forest Data Bank publishes none of this.

protected_areas()
Protected areas covering an area of interest

Administrative boundaries

prg_boundaries()
Administrative boundaries for an area

Looking at what you got

plot_units()
Draw forest units, with context

Cache

Index responses expire on their own; downloads are kept and recorded, so a tile already on disk is never fetched twice.

cache_dir() cache_set_dir()
Cache location
cache_info() cache_clear()
Inspect and prune the download cache
rgeopl-options
Package options
